authorship.scope: Original standalone mathematical exposition, exact equations, worked examples and exercises for the nonlinear least-squares and inverse-problem bridge; inherited manuscripts preserved.

prerequisites.reason: Distinguish damping of a local correction from a lasting parameter penalty.

description: Distinguishes noise modeling from prior information and step damping, derive Tikhonov and weighted least squares, and connect robust loss and validation to reliable inference.
